COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)

   B. Avoiding all community work

   C. Say Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea as rumours only.
